steps.instruction: Put 1 cup of cold cream cheese in a bowl.
Mix just enough to smooth out any lumps.
steps.spoken: Mix just enough to smooth out any lumps. Do not overmix.

steps.instruction: Cream 1 stick of cold unsalted butter in another bowl until smooth and creamy.
Beat in 3 1/2 cups of powdered sugar, in 3 or 4 batches.
steps.spoken: Beat in 3 and a half cups of powdered sugar, in 3 or 4 batches. It may look crumbly at first, but don't worry. It will come together into a ball, like a dough.

steps.instruction: Beat in 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Add all of the cream cheese and mix until smooth.
steps.spoken: Add all of the cream cheese and mix until smooth. Do not overmix, because it can make the frosting runny. This makes about 4 cups.
